desc: Read N, K and array A from stdin.
Compute total = XOR of all elements; set r = min(K, N-K).
If r == 0, answer is 0 if K==0 else total (K=N case); handle accordingly.
Enumerate all combinations of r indices via itertools.combinations; for each, compute XOR of chosen values (loop or functools.reduce).
If r == K, candidate answer is that XOR; else candidate is total ⊕ that XOR (complement). Track maximum.
Implement full solve() with the above logic, print answer, and sanity-check against both samples (7 and 2024).
